title: Almost every slice M_t is countably m-rectifiable with weighted tangent plane T_xM ∩ G(x)^⊥ (Simon Ch. 6, 4.1)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m+1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ L-Lipschitz, and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Borel with |G(x)| ≤ L for all x and the tangential-gradient property (for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every weighted approximate tangent plane Q of (M, θ) at x: G(x) ∈ Q and d/ds f(x + su)|_{s=0} = ⟨G(x), u⟩ for u ∈ Q). Assume the co-area identity for (M, f, G): for every Borel g ≥ 0, t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dH^m is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dH^m dt = ∫_M |G| g dHⁿ (Hᵏ := μHE[k]). Let M_t := {x ∈ M : f(x) = t, G(x) ≠ 0}. Then for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ: M_t is countably m-rectifiable; and for H^m-a.e. x ∈ M_t and every weighted approximate tangent plane Q of (M, θ) at x, the subspace Q ∩ G(x)^⊥ = Q ⊓ (ℝ∙G(x))ᗮ is a weighted approximate tangent plane of (M_t, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M_t θ x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → LipschitzWith L f → Measurable G → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → G x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → (∀ g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖G x‖ₑ * g x ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), CountablyRectifiable m {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ G x ≠ 0} ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ G x ≠ 0}), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt m {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ G x ≠ 0} θ x (Q ⊓ (ℝ ∙ G x)ᗮ)
